description: End-to-end lifecycle management for prepaid charging sessions, including balance inquiries, eligibility checks, real-time reservation, rating, usage reporting, top-up, adjustments, and error recovery in a telco network exposure context.

subscriber_id.description: Unique subscriber identifier (e.g., MSISDN, IMSI, or CRM ID)

account_id.description: Billing account identifier associated with the subscriber

session_id.description: Charging session identifier used for online charging and reservations

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction identifier for top-ups, adjustments, and rating events

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID propagated from network exposure layer for tracing

service_id.description: Identifier for the service being charged (e.g., data, voice, SMS, content partner)

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: query_prepaid_balance
functions.description: Retrieve current prepaid balances and allowances for a subscriber, including monetary and non-monetary buckets.

subscriber_id.description: Identifier of the subscriber whose balance is queried

account_id.description: Optional account ID if the subscriber has multiple prepaid accounts

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID from network exposure or API gateway

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response

request_context.description: Context of the balance inquiry from the network element

location.description: Coarse location info for policy-driven responses

functions.returns: Current prepaid balance snapshot including monetary and resource buckets, their validity, and any pending reservations.

functions.name: check_charging_eligibility
functions.description: Evaluate whether a subscriber is eligible for real-time charging for a given service, considering barring, credit limits, and policy rules.

service_id.description: Service identifier or rating group to be charged

requested_units.description: Units requested by the network function

amount.description: Requested amount of units (e.g., seconds, bytes, events)

charging_characteristics.description: Characteristics that influence eligibility and rating

network_slice.description: 5G network slice or QoS class identifier

functions.returns: Eligibility decision indicating whether charging can proceed, including reasons, applicable profiles, and any required actions (e.g., top-up needed).

functions.name: initiate_charging_session
functions.description: Create a new online charging session with initial unit reservation for a service usage request.

initial_request.description: Details of the initial usage request from the network function

session_start_time.description: Start time of the service session

calling_party.description: Originating subscriber, if different (e.g., for transfer services)

called_party.description: Destination address or called party number

bearer_info.description: Network bearer information for QoS-aware charging

apn.description: Access Point Name for data services

policy_overrides.description: Optional policy overrides for partner or enterprise services

sponsored_data.description: Indicates if data is sponsor-paid and should not decrement user quota

zero_rating.description: Indicates if the usage is zero-rated

preferred_bucket_ids.description: Hint for which balance buckets to charge first

functions.returns: Charging session context including session_id, reserved units, applicable tariff, and session state.

functions.name: update_charging_session
functions.description: Update an ongoing charging session with interim usage reports and additional unit reservations.

usage_report.description: Interim usage details reported by the network function

partial_cdr_reference.description: Reference to a partial CDR or usage record in the network element

additional_request.description: Optional request for additional units if more usage is expected

functions.returns: Updated reservation status, including newly reserved units (if any), remaining balance, and any policy actions such as throttling or termination advice.

functions.name: finalize_charging_session
functions.description: Finalize a charging session to commit charges and release any remaining reserved units.

final_usage_report.description: Final usage report consolidating total consumed units

cdr_metadata.description: Metadata to support CDR generation and offline rating reconciliation

functions.returns: Final charging outcome including debited amounts from each bucket, any remaining reserved units released, and a transaction_id for audit.

functions.name: abort_charging_session
functions.description: Abort an ongoing charging session, rolling back reserved units when appropriate and marking the session as failed or cancelled.

rollback_policy.description: Controls how reserved units are treated on abort

partial_commit.description: If true, commit part of the consumed units before release

commit_consumed_units.description: Optional details if partial_commit is true

functions.returns: Confirmation of session abort, rollback results on reserved units, and any residual charges that were committed.

functions.name: rate_usage_event
functions.description: Rate a discrete prepaid usage event (e.g., SMS, one-time content purchase) and charge it immediately against available balances.

event_details.description: Details describing the usage event to be rated

attributes.description: Additional rating attributes from network exposure

price_override.description: Optional negotiated or promotional price override

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate rating without debiting balance

functions.returns: Rating result including rated amount, buckets impacted, final charged amount, and a transaction_id; may include a simulation flag if dry_run was used.

functions.name: apply_prepaid_topup
functions.description: Apply a prepaid top-up or recharge to a subscriber account, potentially activating bonus buckets and promotions.

amount.description: Top-up amount in the account currency

payment_reference.description: External reference for the payment transaction

promotion_context.description: Context for promotional rules linked to the top-up

eligibility_override.description: Force apply campaign even if normal eligibility fails

idempotency_key.description: Key to safely retry top-up without double posting

functions.returns: Top-up result including updated balances, any bonus or promotional buckets created, and a transaction_id for reconciliation.

functions.name: reverse_topup_transaction
functions.description: Reverse or partially rollback a previously applied top-up transaction in case of payment failures or disputes.

transaction_id.description: Identifier of the original top-up transaction to reverse

partial_reversal_amount.description: Amount to reverse in case of partial reversal

reversal_policy.description: Controls rollback of bonus and promotional balances

protect_consumed_amount.description: If true, will not reverse amounts already consumed by usage

functions.returns: Reversal outcome including adjusted balances, impacted buckets, and linkage to both original and reversal transaction_ids.

functions.name: apply_prepaid_adjustment
functions.description: Apply a manual or system-driven adjustment (credit or debit) to a prepaid account for dispute resolution or corrections.

adjustment_amount.description: Amount to adjust (positive number, direction decided by adjustment_type)

allocation_policy.description: Controls allocation of adjustment across buckets

target_bucket_id.description: Specific bucket to be adjusted, if applicable

initiator.description: Information about who or what initiated the adjustment

functions.returns: Adjustment result including updated balances, affected bucket list, and generated transaction_id.

functions.name: get_charging_session_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and context of a charging session, including reservations and related rating actions.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response

functions.returns: Charging session snapshot including state (active, finalized, aborted), reserved and consumed units, and any associated transaction_ids.

functions.name: list_prepaid_transactions
functions.description: List prepaid-related transactions (sessions, top-ups, adjustments, rated events) for a subscriber with filtering and pagination.

filters.description: Filter criteria for the transaction list

result_codes.description: Filter by outcome/result codes (e.g., SUCCESS, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE)

functions.returns: Paginated list of prepaid transactions with basic details and references to more detailed records.

functions.name: retry_failed_charging_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed online charging operation (session update, finalize, or usage event rating) with optional parameter overrides.

failed_operation_id.description: Identifier of the failed operation in the charging system

retry_strategy.description: Strategy for retrying the failed operation

parameter_overrides.description: Optional partial override of original operation parameters; structure depends on operation_type

rating_correction.description: Overrides for usage event rating retries

functions.returns: Result of the retry attempt including final status (success, still_failed, simulated), any new transaction_ids, and diagnostic information.

functions.name: search_prepaid_charging_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across prepaid_charging entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching prepaid_charging entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_prepaid_charging_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N prepaid_charging records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_prepaid_charging_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many prepaid_charging records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_prepaid_charging_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many prepaid_charging records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_prepaid_charging_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of prepaid_charging data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_prepaid_charging_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a prepaid_charging dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_prepaid_charging_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more prepaid_charging entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_prepaid_charging_snapshot
functions.description: Restore prepaid_charging state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_prepaid_charging_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the prepaid_charging workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_prepaid_charging_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across prepaid_charging metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_prepaid_charging_audit_events
functions.description: Search the prepaid_charging audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_prepaid_charging_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers prepaid_charging workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_prepaid_charging_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for prepaid_charging events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_prepaid_charging_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for prepaid_charging events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_prepaid_charging_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off prepaid_charging job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_prepaid_charging_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled prepaid_charging jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_prepaid_charging_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled prepaid_charging job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_prepaid_charging_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a prepaid_charging operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_prepaid_charging_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a prepaid_charging action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_prepaid_charging_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a prepaid_charging approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_prepaid_charging_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any prepaid_charging entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_prepaid_charging_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a prepaid_charging entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_prepaid_charging_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling prepaid_charging behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_prepaid_charging_policies
functions.description: List prepaid_charging policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_prepaid_charging_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two prepaid_charging-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_prepaid_charging_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a prepaid_charging entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_prepaid_charging_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many prepaid_charging entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
